tools.name: check_links_in_text
tools.description: Find and check every link in a block of text: an email, chat message, ticket or document. Use it before acting on a message that contains links. Returns each link with ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK. Without an API key, the first 5 links are checked; with one, up to 20.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_link, check_before_login, check_before_payment, check_links_in_text · Private data: check_link, check_before_login, check_links_in_text · Public sink: check_link, check_links_in_text · Destructive: check_before_login, check_before_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_link, check_before_login, check_before_payment, check_links_in_text · Private data: check_link, check_before_login, check_links_in_text · Public sink: check_link, check_links_in_text · Destructive: check_before_login, check_before_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
